answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 36561 Country: India Title: One of our friend who is about 30 years old always wears a white safa Question: One of our friend who is about 30 years old always wears a white safa. One other friend who is about 17 years saw a dream about the above friend that he comes to meet a Maulana sahib and the Maulana sahib opens his safa and throws it. We have asked the tabeer from the same Maulana whom he saw in the dream, so the Maulana instructed not to wear the safa always, but sometimes. The dream time cannot be remembered. Please reply quickly. Answer ID: 36561 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 534/301/H=1433) The meaning of dream is that do not consider white turban (amamah) necessary rather wear black amamah sometime with the intention of following sunnah (other than the month of Muharram). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
